capabilities: , Preview and edit views in real-time
extras: The plugin is available as a beta version; users are advised to turn off JavaScript execution in settings if they do not trust the scripts they write.
intentEvidence: Custom Views renders matching notes with your own HTML, CSS and JavaScript, while the data stays in ordinary Markdown and frontmatter.
problem: Standard note display in Obsidian is rigid, preventing users from creating purpose-built, highly customized visual representations of their structured data.

relations.evidence: Custom Views uses Obsidian's Bases filters for its rules, so turn on Bases in Settings → Core plugins.

summary: Custom Views renders notes using custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript based on defined filter rules, allowing users to transform note presentation.
